name: @alpha-code/ext
description: alpha-code backend isolation extension — zero-edit opencode server plugin + tools. Bundled to self-contained ESM (see DECISIONS.md ADR-006) and loaded into the embedded Electron-Node server via OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT injected by ui-mac's sidecar (so it applies to every project without touching opencode's own .opencode/). Runtime entry is the built bundle; types resolve from source.
